description: Image Description: The image shows five remote controls placed side by side on a carpeted surface. From left to right, the first four remotes are standard-sized, featuring numerous buttons including power, volume, and channel controls. They vary slightly in design, button layout, and color schemes. The fifth remote on the right is significantly larger than the others and is still in its packaging. It is labeled as a "Jumbo Universal" remote and has large buttons with clear labels such as SET, TV
